metadata.methods_description: Data were collected over 60 sessions across 10 days, with sessions of approximately 25 minutes divided into five segments: a 2-minute pre-treatment baseline, a 5-minute still treatment period, a 5-minute treatment period with allowed movement, another 5-minute still treatment period, and a 2-minute post-treatment baseline. Cell type (live, dead/x-rayed, or medium only) was randomized and presented under double-blind conditions to both the practitioner and experimenter: 40 sessions involved live cells, 10 sessions involved medium only, and 10 sessions involved dead/x-rayed cells. Matching control cell sets (40 total) were treated by a sham therapist in a separate location to control for time and equipment effects; behavioral outcome measures for these controls are included in the dataset.
